= camel get timeline

Get what the routes did per second, the errors, and the failed and slowest exchanges


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel get timeline [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--duration` | How long to keep watching or following, in millis or as a duration such as 30s (default: until Enter is pressed) |  | long
| `--errors` | List the errors by route and exception instead of the routes |  | boolean
| `--exchanges` | List the exchanges kept per second (the failed, handled and recovered ones and the 3 slowest) instead of the routes |  | boolean
| `--filter` | Filter by route ID (pattern) |  | String
| `--json` | Output in JSON Format |  | boolean
| `--limit` | Filter the exchanges by limiting to the given number of rows |  | int
| `--seconds` | The number of seconds to show, up to the seconds the integration records | 60 | int
| `--short-uri` | List endpoint URI without query parameters (short) |  | boolean
| `--sort` | Sort the exchanges by pid, name, age, elapsed (the slowest first), or since (the newest first) | since | String
| `--watch` | Execute periodically and showing output fullscreen |  | boolean
| `--wide-uri` | List endpoint URI in full details |  | boolean
| `-h,--help` | Display this help and exit |  | boolean
|===
